# gdrive_file (Data Source)

Read file or folder metadata. drive_id identifies the containing Shared Drive; it is null for My Drive items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gdrive_file" "folder" {
  id = "FOLDER_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) File or folder ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Item description.
- `drive_id` (String) Containing Shared Drive ID, if any.
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type.
- `name` (String) Item name.
- `parents` (List of String) Parent folder IDs.
- `trashed` (Boolean) Whether the item is in the trash.
